description: Geometric weak-gauge kinetic coefficients Z_W/kappa for the published common-vacuum profile pair, inherited value-for-value from the predecessor note 'Geometric Weak-Gauge Response and Electromagnetic Profile Dependence' (22 October 2026). The predecessor's reproducibility bundle was not present in Cbaird26/mqgt-scf-continued at commit 3a8a1b029e2923ce3fde3335fbc710ebf618a38b; the values below are the eighteen-significant-digit figures printed in the shared research transcript and are NOT recomputed in this continuation.

source.note_title: Geometric Weak-Gauge Response and Electromagnetic Profile Dependence

definition: Z_W[f,R]/kappa = sum_j w_j b_W(a_j, R) with b_W = 12 b_{W,0} + 28 b_{W,1} + 16 b_{W,2} the full geometric response (orbital, spin-potential, Pauli contact, Pauli derivative terms) of the torsion-free SU(2)-equivariant extension, evaluated at the common radius R_* of the published pair.
positivity_certificate_quoted: b_W > 0.3164962993 for u in [0.59, 0.60] (predecessor exact rational certificate; not rerun here)
